query.sql: SELECT code, name, customer_type, report_template, report_language, containment_hours, report_days FROM erp.customers WHERE code = %(code)s

SELECT m.lot_code, m.supplier_code, m.material, m.received_date, m.qty, m.unit, m.certificate_ok, m.notes FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.material_lots m ON m.lot_code IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) WHERE l.lot_code = %(lot_code)s

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT c.complaint_id, c.customer_code, c.part_ref, c.lot_code, c.received_date, c.defect, c.qty_affected, c.status, c.report_8d_id FROM erp.complaints c WHERE (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR c.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(customer_code)s::text IS NULL OR c.customer_code = %(customer_code)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR c.received_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR c.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY c.received_date, c.complaint_id LIMIT 200

SELECT p.ref AS part_ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die, count(*) AS lots, min(l.production_date) AS first_production_date, max(l.production_date) AS last_production_date FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.parts p ON p.ref = l.part_ref WHERE %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) GROUP BY p.ref, p.customer_code, p.weld_cell, p.uses_weld_nut, p.press, p.die ORDER BY p.ref LIMIT 200

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.shift, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, l.production_date, l.lot_code

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.lots l JOIN erp.shipments s ON s.lot_code = l.lot_code WHERE l.part_ref = ANY(%(part_refs)s) AND %(material_lot_code)s IN (l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code) ORDER BY l.part_ref, s.ship_date, s.shipment_id

SELECT l.lot_code, l.part_ref, l.order_id, l.production_date, l.shift, l.press, l.weld_cell, l.qty_produced, l.qty_scrap, l.status, l.steel_lot_code, l.wire_lot_code, l.nut_lot_code, l.ecoat_lot_code FROM erp.lots l WHERE l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s AND l.production_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND (%(wire_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.wire_lot_code = %(wire_lot_code)s) AND (%(steel_lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR l.steel_lot_code = %(steel_lot_code)s) AND (%(weld_cell)s::text IS NULL OR l.weld_cell = %(weld_cell)s) AND (%(shift)s::text IS NULL OR l.shift = %(shift)s) AND (%(status)s::text IS NULL OR l.status = %(status)s) ORDER BY l.production_date, l.lot_code LIMIT 200

SELECT s.shipment_id, s.lot_code, l.part_ref, s.customer_code, s.ship_date, s.qty FROM erp.shipments s JOIN erp.lots l ON l.lot_code = s.lot_code WHERE (%(lot_code)s::text IS NULL OR s.lot_code = %(lot_code)s) AND (%(part_ref)s::text IS NULL OR l.part_ref = %(part_ref)s) AND (%(from_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date >= %(from_date)s) AND (%(to_date)s::date IS NULL OR s.ship_date <= %(to_date)s) ORDER BY s.ship_date, s.shipment_id LIMIT 200

similar.action_summary: Sharpened punch (edge radius restored) and replaced plug gauge. Standardized intermediate checks every 10,000 strokes (PROC-L1-AFILADO-01 v3).
similar.discriminating_evidence: Same part (AR-1007), same defect (undersized hole Ø11.11-11.18 mm and burr 0.21-0.33 mm), same die (MT-07), and same press (PR-250). No contradictory evidence in the new complaint.

problem_statement.text: 12 power inverter brackets (ref. AR-1010, lot L26252-AR1010-01) exhibited spinning M8 weld nuts during tightening at 25 Nm, failing torque-out (≥40 Nm) and push-out force (≥4.0 kN) requirements.

rows.text: Spinning M8 weld nut on power inverter bracket (ref. AR-1010, special characteristic: weld nut torque, SC). Torque-out requirement: ≥40 Nm; measured: 19–31 Nm (7 pcs) and 42–47 Nm (3 pcs). Push-out force requirement: ≥4.0 kN; measured: 2.1–2.9 kN (7 pcs).
rows.label: What

rows.text: Detected at OEM Norte e-drive module line (inverter fixing, station ED-4). Originated in weld cell CR-02 (press PR-400) during production of lot L26252-AR1010-01.
rows.label: Where

rows.text: Production: 2026-09-09 (afternoon shift). Shipments: 2026-09-14 (AL-26-00573) and 2026-09-16 (AL-26-00572). Detection: 2026-09-22. Complaint issued: 2026-09-23.
rows.label: When

rows.text: Detected by OEM Norte during assembly. Customer contact: M. Ruiz, Supplier Quality Engineer (m.ruiz@oem-norte.example, +34 948 000 312).

rows.text: Detected during tightening of M8 fixing bolt to 25 Nm (nut spun, inverter could not be fixed). Interface showed flattened projections without fusion and bright metallic residue.

hypotheses.title: Electrode misalignment in weld cell CR-02 after maintenance, causing off-centre projection welds
hypotheses.rationale: The defect (flattened projections without fusion, bright metallic residue) matches the mechanism of off-centre welding due to electrode misalignment. The FMEA row explicitly lists this cause. However, there is no evidence of maintenance intervention on CR-02 prior to the production of lot L26252-AR1010-01 (2026-09-09).
hypotheses.verification: Review maintenance records for CR-02 between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-09 to confirm if any intervention occurred.

hypotheses.title: Weld nuts with Zn-Ni coating at upper tolerance limit combined with unadjusted weld schedule
hypotheses.rationale: The nut lot S-BIDA-260136 was used for the complained lot. The previous complaint (8D-ARGA-2025-008, ) identified Zn-Ni coating at the upper limit (11.5–12.0 µm) as the root cause for low torque-out. The FMEA row covers this cause. The evaluation report confirms that S-BIDA had a history of coating thickness at the upper limit, and the control plan specifies a restricted window of 8–11 µm. However…
hypotheses.verification: Check incoming inspection records for lot S-BIDA-260136 to confirm the Zn-Ni coating thickness. If it was at the upper limit (11–12 µm), the weld schedule may not have been adjusted for this condition.

hypotheses.title: Weld schedule not validated for the specific combination of materials (steel, wire, nut) used in the complained lot
hypotheses.rationale: The wire lot S-GOIE-260117 had a change in the manufacturer of origin, which could affect weld parameters. The FMEA does not explicitly cover the interaction between material combinations (steel, wire, nut) and weld schedule validation. The defect mechanism (insufficient fusion) suggests a potential energy mismatch at the interface.
hypotheses.verification: Review weld schedule validation records for the combination of steel lot S-ULTZ-260173, wire lot S-GOIE-260117, and nut lot S-BIDA-260136. Perform a trial weld with these materials to verify torque-out performance.
hypotheses.fmea_gap: AMFE lacks a row for interaction between material combinations (steel, wire, nut) and weld schedule validation.
